## File: facebookresearch_chameleon/chameleon/miniviewer/miniviewer.py

```
['run the chameleon miniviewer Flask server with SocketIO for streaming text and image generation', 'run convert_options to transform UI option dictionaries into Chameleon Options objects for inference', 'run UIDecoder to decode GPU tokens into text strings or base64 encoded PNG images', 'run the generation thread that processes pending requests and streams tokens via SocketIO', 'run the queue position thread that broadcasts request queue positions to connected clients']
```

